question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart is about Country-wise Global Exports Presentation.

By how much does the value of the exports of the UK exceed that of Australia (in billion Rs)?
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 2,000.

Given that

Total export = Rs. 14400 billion

The value of the exports of UK = 14400 × 125/360 = Rs 5000 billion

The value of the exports of Australia = 14400 × 75/360 = Rs 3000 billion

Hence, the required value = 5000 - 3000 = Rs. 2000 billion
question_hi:
दिए गए पाई-चार्ट का अध्ययन कीजिए और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

पाई-चार्ट देश-वार वैश्विक निर्यात प्रस्तुति के बारे में है।

ब्रिटेन के निर्यात का मूल्य ऑस्ट्रेलिया के निर्यात (बिलियन रुपये में) से कितना अधिक है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 2,000 है।

दिया गया है

कुल निर्यात = 14400 अरब रुपये

यूके के निर्यात का मूल्य = 14400 × 125/360 = 5000 अरब रुपये

ऑस्ट्रेलिया के निर्यात का मूल्य = 14400 × 75/360 = 3000 अरब रुपये

अतः, अभीष्ट मान = 5000 - 3000 = 2000 बिलियन रुपये

question: Following is the figure showing the sales of different items in a stationary shop. Which product recorded the highest percentage change from 2020 to 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. Notebook.

Given that

The percentage change in Geometry from 2020 to 2021 = {(44 - 32)/32} × 100 = 37.5%

The percentage change in Notebook from 2020 to 2021 = {(35 - 25)/25} × 100 = 40%

The percentage change in Charts from 2020 to 2021 = {(37 - 27)/27} × 100 = 37.04%

The percentage change in Pages from 2020 to 2021 = {(26 - 20)/20} × 100 = 30%

Therefore, the highest percentage change from 2020 to 2021 is for Notebooks.
question_hi: एक स्टेशनरी की दुकान की विभिन्न वस्तुओं की बिक्री दर्शाने वाला आरेख निम्नलिखित है। किस उत्पाद ने 2020 से 2021 तक सबसे अधिक प्रतिशत परिवर्तन दर्ज किया?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् नोटबुक है।

दिया गया है

2020 से 2021 तक ज्यामिति में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = {(44 - 32)/32} × 100 = 37.5%

2020 से 2021 तक नोटबुक में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = {(35 - 25)/25} × 100 = 40%

2020 से 2021 तक संचित्र में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = {(37 - 27)/27} × 100 = 37.04%

2020 से 2021 तक पृष्ठ में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = {(26 - 20)/20} × 100 = 30%

इसलिए, 2020 से 2021 तक सबसे अधिक प्रतिशत परिवर्तन नोटबुक के लिए है।

question:
The following table shows the percentage of students passing out of four colleges (A,B,C and D) over four years. Study the table and answer the question that follows.

Years College A College B College C College D
2019 68 78 56 78
2020 72 86 78 82
2021 78 91 82 85
2022 80 87 84 87

 

In which college is the average percentage of passing students over the given four years the least?
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. College A.

Given that

The total number of passing students of college A = 68 + 72 + 78 + 80 = 298

The total number of passing students of college B = 78 + 86 + 91 + 87 = 342

The total number of passing students of college C = 56 + 78 + 82 + 84 = 300

The total number of passing students of college D = 78 + 82 + 85 + 87 = 332

Hence, the average percentage of passing students over the given four years is minimum for college A

question: If the total amount spent on sports during the year was Rs. 75,00,000 then how much (in Rs.) was spent on cricket and hockey together?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. ₹24,75,000.

The total amount spent on sports during the year = Rs. 75,00,000

According to the question,

The amount spent on cricket = 7500000 × 20/100 = Rs.1500000

The amount spent on hockey = 7500000 × 13/100 = Rs. 975000

Hence,

The total amount spent on cricket and hockey together = 1500000 + 975000 = ₹24,75,000

question: Find the total number of children in the four villages.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 960.

Number of children = Total population - (Number of males + number of females)

Now,

Number of children in village A = 1500 - (820 + 400) = 280

Number of children in village B = 1600 - (1040 + 220) = 340

Number of children in village C = 1400 - (760 + 420) = 220

Number of children in village D = 1000 - (580 + 300) = 120

Hence,

Total number of children in all four villages = 280 + 340 + 220 + 120 = 960

अब,

गांव A में बच्चों की संख्या = 1500 - (820 + 400) = 280

गांव B में बच्चों की संख्या = 1600 - (1040 + 220) = 340

गांव C में बच्चों की संख्या = 1400 - (760 + 420) = 220

गांव D में बच्चों की संख्या = 1000 - (580 + 300) = 120

अतः,

चारों गाँवों में बच्चों की कुल संख्या = 280 + 340 + 220 + 120 = 960

question: How many more people work in the service sector when compared to the number of people who engage themselves in business?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 25,002.

Number of people working in the service sector = 42°

⇒ \(\left ( \frac{42}{360} \right )\times 5,00,040\) = 58,338

Number of people engaged in the business = 24°

⇒\(\left ( \frac{24}{360} \right )\times 5,00,040\) = 33,336

So, People working in the service sector as compared to the business = 58,338 - 33,336 = 25,002
question_hi: व्यवसाय में लगे लोगों की संख्या की तुलना में सेवा क्षेत्र में कितने अधिक लोग काम करते हैं?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 25,002 है।

सेवा क्षेत्र में कार्यरत लोगों की संख्या = 42°

⇒ \(\left ( \frac{42}{360} \right )\times 5,00,040\) = 58,338

व्यवसाय में संलग्न व्यक्तियों की संख्या = 24°

⇒\(\left ( \frac{24}{360} \right )\times 5,00,040\) = 33,336

इसलिए, व्यवसाय की तुलना में सेवा क्षेत्र में कार्यरत व्यक्तियों की अधिकता = 58,338 - 33,336 = 25,002

question: How much does he spend on children's fees in a year (in Rs)?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 1,00,800.

The monthly income of the man is Rs 84,000.

The monthly income of the man = 100% = 84000

1% = 840

The percentage of expenditure on children's fees = 10%

The monthly spend on children's fees = 84000 × 10/100 = Rs 8400

Hence, Yearly spend on children's fees = 8400 × 12 = Rs 100800

आदमी की मासिक आय = 100% = 84000

1% = 840

बच्चों की फीस पर व्यय का प्रतिशत = 10%

बच्चों की फीस पर मासिक खर्च = 84000 × 10/100 = 8400 रुपये

अतः, बच्चों की फीस पर वार्षिक खर्च = 8400 × 12 = 100800 रुपये

question_hi: शहर R की 60 वर्ष से कम आयु की पुरुष जनसंख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

question: What is the sum of the central angles made by sector P4 and sector P6?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 126°.

Total number of books printed = 24 + 36 + 60 + 56 + 62 + 42 = 280

Number of books printed by sector P4 and P6 = 56 + 42 = 98

Hence, Required central angle = (98/280) × 360 = 126°
question_hi: त्रिज्यखंड P4 और त्रिज्यखंड P6 द्वारा बनाए गए केंद्रीय कोणों का योग क्या है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 126° है।

कुल मुद्रित पुस्तकों की संख्या = 24 + 36 + 60 + 56 + 62 + 42 = 280

त्रिज्यखंड P4 और P6 द्वारा मुद्रित पुस्तकों की संख्या = 56 + 42 = 98

अतः, अभीष्ट केंद्रीय कोण = (98/280) × 100 = 126°

question: What was the difference between the average monthly income of Jyoti over all the six years taken together and Aman's monthly income in the year 2006 (in Rs)?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 3000.

Sum of jyoti's income in all the 6 years = (9 + 11 + 18 + 27 + 26 + 35) × 1000 = Rs 126000

We know that,

Average = Sum of observations/Number of observations

So, Average = 126000/6 = Rs 21000

Aman's income in 2006 = Rs 18000

Hence, Required difference = 21000 - 18000 = Rs 3000
question_hi: सभी छह वर्षों में मिलाकर ज्योति की औसत मासिक आय और वर्ष 2006 में अमन की मासिक आय के बीच क्या अंतर था (रुपये में)?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 3000 है।

सभी 6 वर्षों में ज्योति की आय का योग = (9 + 11 + 18 + 27 + 26 + 35) × 1000 = 126000 रुपये

हम जानते हैं कि,

औसत = प्रेक्षणों का योग/प्रेक्षणों की संख्या

इसलिए, औसत = 126000/6 = 21000 रुपये

2006 में अमन की आय = 18000 रुपये

अतः, आवश्यक अंतर = 21000 - 18000 = 3000 रुपये

question: The number of parks in Delhi is what percentage of the total number of parks in all the four cities taken together? (Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place)

अतः, अभीष्ट प्रतिशत = (346/1340) × 100 = 25.8%

question: In percentage terms, how many more pages did Rishi read than Neha?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 20%.

From the given graph

Rishi reads = 60 pages and, Nishi reads = 50 pages

Now, Difference between the number of pages read by Rishi and Neha = 60 - 50 = 10

Required percentage = \(\frac{10}{50}\times 100\) = 20%
question_hi: प्रतिशत के संदर्भ में, नेहा की तुलना में ऋषि ने कितने पृष्ठ अधिक पढ़े?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 यानी 20% है।

​दिए गए ग्राफ़ से

ऋषि पढ़ता है = 60 पृष्ठ और, निशि पढ़ता है = 50 पृष्ठ

अब, ऋषि और नेहा द्वारा पढ़े गए पृष्ठों की संख्या के बीच अंतर = 60 - 50 = 10

आवश्यक प्रतिशत = \(\frac{10}{50}\times 100\) = 20%

question: Find the ratio of tourists from the country coming in during March and April.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4  i.e. 9 : 10.

The Ratio of tourists in countries A and B in March = 3 : 2

Percentage of tourists visiting in March = 20%

Total number of tourists = 60000

Total number of Tourists visit in March = 20% of 60000 = 12000

Total number of tourists visiting from company A in March = 3x/5x × 12000 = 3/5 × 12000 = 7200

Now, the Ratio of tourists in countries A and B in April = 8 : 7

Percentage of tourists visiting in April = 25%

Total number of tourists = 60000

Total number of Tourists visit in April = 25% of 60000 = 15000

Total number of tourists visiting from company A in April = 8x/15x × 15000 = 8 × 1000 = 8000

Hence, Required ratio = 7200 : 8000 = 72 : 80 = 9 : 10
question_hi: मार्च और अप्रैल के दौरान देश A से आने वाले पर्यटकों का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिये
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 9 : 10 है।

मार्च में देश A और B में पर्यटकों का अनुपात = 3 : 2

मार्च में आने वाले पर्यटकों का प्रतिशत = 20%

पर्यटकों की कुल संख्या = 60000

मार्च में पर्यटकों की कुल संख्या = 60000 का 20% = 12000

मार्च में कंपनी A से आने वाले पर्यटकों की कुल संख्या = 3x/5x × 12000 = 3/5 × 12000 = 7200

अब, अप्रैल में A और B देशों में पर्यटकों का अनुपात = 8 : 7

अप्रैल में आने वाले पर्यटकों का प्रतिशत = 25%

पर्यटकों की कुल संख्या = 60000

अप्रैल में पर्यटकों की कुल संख्या = 60000 का 25% = 15000

अप्रैल में कंपनी A से आने वाले पर्यटकों की कुल संख्या = 8x/15x × 15000 = 8 × 1000 = 8000

अतः, अभीष्ट अनुपात = 7200 : 8000 = 72 : 80 = 9 : 10

question: What was the percentage increase during 2020 - 2021 over 2018 - 2019 in Education outley?

question_hi: शिक्षा परिव्यय में 2018 - 2019 की तुलना में 2020 - 2021 के दौरान कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई थी?

question: In which year was there maximum percentage increase in the export of apples to that of the previous years?
solution:

Percentage increase in 2007 = (9.5 - 10.8)/10.8 × 100 = -12.03%

Percentage increase in 2008 = (11.4 - 9.5)/9.5 × 100 = 20%

Hence,

Maximum percentage increase in the export of apples to that of the previous years in 2005

question: What is the central angle corresponding to the expenditure spent on Education?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e 55.8°.

Let the central angle correspond to the expenditure spent on Education be x

Spend on Education = 5425

Total expenditures = 5250 + 6125 + 7525 + 6475 + 4200 + 5425 = 35000

⇒ 5425/35000 = x/360

⇒ x = (5425 × 360)/35000

⇒ x = 55.8°

शिक्षा पर खर्च = 5425

कुल व्यय = 5250 + 6125 + 7525 + 6475 + 4200 + 5425 = 35000

⇒ 5425/35000 = x/360

⇒ x = (5425 × 360)/35000

⇒ x = 55.8°

question: What is the total number of children in areas P and Q together?
